notes.name: led_timer.txt
notes.text:
12V push-to-on LED timer:
- Created led_timer.kicad_pro/.kicad_sch directly in /home/cua/kicad_project/ and exported led_timer.net in KiCad format. Step 68 confirms clean title and saved schematic status.
- Transistor_BJT:BC547 Q1 and BC557 Q2 use 1=C, 2=B, 3=E. Q2 mirrored vertically with y so emitter is up. Device:C_Polarized C1=1000uF positive up; Device:R R1=2.2M horizontal, R2/R3=1k, R4=470; Device:LED rotated once cathode down; Switch:SW_Push.
- Supply +12V feeds SW1.1, R2.1, Q2.3. Timing node SW1.2/C1.1/R1.1; R1.2 to Q1.2. Q1.1 through R3 to Q2 base/R2 lower junction. Q2 collector through R4 to LED anode; capacitor negative, Q1 emitter and LED cathode use common GND. No signal labels.
- ERC found only two undriven power-input errors (+12V/GND), zero warnings. Delete All Markers (440,722), Close (605,722). No extra power flags added.
- Export recipe: File (10,58), hover Export (83,192), Netlist (198,219), Export (650,774), verify destination, Save (757,913), then Ctrl+S clears export-induced title star.
- Prior simple value edits and empty-netlist task scored 1.00; buck 0.67; astable 0.00. These support GUI persistence recipes but do not establish arbitrary full-build correctness. Current circuit is visually checked against intent, not independently scored or netlist-parsed.
